description: Infrastructure as a Service - Cloud model delivering on-demand virtualized hardware, networking, and storage.
Platform as a Service - Cloud model offering managed development environments without OS management overhead.
Software as a Service - Fully managed cloud applications accessed directly by users over the web.
Anything as a Service - Broad term encompassing all services delivered over the internet via cloud infrastructure.
Cloud Service Provider - Commercial vendor delivering scalable computing, storage, or software services over networks.
Virtual Desktop Infrastructure - Desktop environment hosted on centralized servers accessed remotely by thin clients.
Virtual Machine - Software emulation of a physical computer system running its own guest operating system.
Virtual Machine Manager - Hypervisor software creating and managing virtual machines on physical hosts.
Application Programming Interface - Protocols enabling distinct software programs to communicate and exchange data.
Software Development Kit - Software toolset and libraries provided to developers to build platform applications.
Infrastructure as Code - Provisioning and managing IT infrastructure using code definitions and automated scripts.
Cloud Security Posture Management - Automated tools checking cloud configurations against compliance baselines.
Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform - Integrated suite securing cloud application development and runtime environment.
Cloud Workload Protection Platform - Agent-based security platform guarding workloads across cloud environments.
